properties.title: ZOO-Project: news about the Open Source Generic Processing Engine
properties.description: The ZOO-Project is an open-source processing platform released under the MIT/X11 Licence. It provides the polyglot ZOO-Kernel, a server implementation of the Web Processing Service (WPS) (1.0.0 and 2.0.0), and the OGC API - Processes standards published by the OGC. It contains ZOO-Services, a minimal set of ready-to-use services that can be used as a base to create more useful services. It provides the ZOO-API, initially only available from the JavaScript service implementation, which exposes ZOO-Kernel variables and functions to the language used to implement the service. It contains the ZOO-Client, a JavaScript API that can be used from a client application to interact with a WPS server.
